answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 37483 Country: Bangladesh Title: I am 28 years old male. My marriage is very soon. My question is that can I use any engagement (like ring, nose pin, etc.) Question: I am 28 years old male. My marriage is very soon. My question is that can I use any engagement (like ring, nose pin, etc.). Does Islam allow engagement? Please reply me answer on Islamic Shariah/Fatwa. Answer ID: 37483 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 375/307/B=1433) Mangani and the practice of exchanging gifts is merely a ritual which is not proved in Islam. But in mangani if any ring etc is presented then it shall be a gift as per the Shariah. There is no harm in using it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
